8020154.sourceDescription: Recreate that Great Hall atmosphere at home, watching candles flicker gently above you as if suspended by invisible threads. These floating candle string lights bring Hogwarts charm to your space with 12 candle-style LED lights that sway and glow softly from their string. Battery-powered and wireless, they hang almost anywhere - draped across a bedroom ceiling, nestled on bookshelves, or woven into your Christmas tree. Each candle flickers with a gentle glow that mimics real flame, creating that authentic atmosphere without the worry of actual fire. The LED tips create a convincing floating illusion when viewed from a distance, especially in dim lighting. You'll get 12 candle capsule LED bulbs included, and they run on 3 AAA batteries (not included) so no hunting for plug sockets is needed. They're designed with care for those sensitive to flashing lights. . 6km7qrs3.baseName: Walplus 300 LED Lights Artificial Christmas Tree 90 cm Wide - White - 180 cm
6km7qrs3.variantName: Walplus 300 LED Lights Artificial Christmas Tree 90 cm Wide - White - 180 cm
6km7qrs3.sourceDescription: This Artificial Christmas Tree with LED is a beautifully crafted cone-shaped tree that captures the spirit of the holiday season. Standing 180 cm tall, it features a sleek, modern design characterized by simplicity and functionality, making it a perfect fit for both living rooms and sheltered outdoor areas. Equipped with dynamic LED string lights, this seasonal décor not only brightens up spaces but also adds a touch of festive charm. Its PVC and steel construction ensures durability, supporting annual use across seasons. Material Composition: This artificial tree is crafted using high-quality PVC and steel, ensuring it has a robust structure capable of standing upright in various environments. The PVC material is abrasion-resistant, allowing for many years of festive celebration without wear and tear. Dynamic LED Lights: Equipped with LED string lights that feature dynamic lighting patterns, the tree enhances festive ambiance with changing patterns and colors. The preset options include 8 distinct flash modes, offering a captivating visual display that transforms any space. Simple Assembly: Assembling the tree is straightforward, designed for two people using a screwdriver as per the manufacturer's instructions. This ensures a stable and secure setup, allowing the tree to stand gracefully throughout the holiday season. Space-Efficient Design: With a cone shape and a bottom diameter of 90 cm, this tree is ideal for compact spaces like small living rooms or terraces. It maximizes vertical space usage, providing ample room for festive decoration while maintaining an elegant, understated presence. Versatile Power Source: The tree is powered by a USB plug, offering convenience and flexibility in setup. It eliminates the need for traditional power outlets, making it suitable for areas where such options are limited or unavailable ensuring hassle-free installation. Product Specifications Colour: White Material: PVC and steel Tree height: 180 cm Bottom diameter: 90 cm Durable Number of PVC tips: 564 Lights type: LED string lights Lights color: Black Number of LEDs: 300 Distance between LEDs: 10 cm LED flash modes: 8 Power source: USB Batteries Included: No Voltage: 5 Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Christmas tree 1 x Stand 1 x LED string light This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

wbx8j3ma.baseName: Neo Christmas Tree Stand for Real Trees - Black
wbx8j3ma.variantName: Neo Christmas Tree Stand for Real Trees - Black
wbx8j3ma.sourceDescription: Keep your real Christmas tree securely supported throughout the festive season with the Neo Extra Large Christmas Tree Stand. Designed for trees up to 2.5m (8ft 2in) tall, this sturdy stand combines a wide base with four steel legs to provide reliable support for your Christmas display. The green plastic reservoir is complemented by contrasting red steel legs for a traditional festive appearance. Four adjustable securing screws hold the tree trunk firmly in position and accommodate trunk diameters from 5cm to 14cm, making it suitable for a variety of real Christmas trees. A built-in 3.3L water reservoir allows the tree trunk to remain in water, helping you maintain your real tree throughout the Christmas period. The wide 57cm base provides additional stability while remaining compact enough for use in living rooms, conservatories and other indoor festive displays. Extra-large stand for real Christmas trees Suitable for trees up to 2.5m (8ft 2in) tall Accommodates tree trunks from 5cm to 14cm in diameter Four adjustable screws securely hold the trunk in position Four sturdy steel legs provide a wide, stable base Green plastic reservoir with contrasting red legs Built-in 3.3L water reservoir Allows the tree trunk to remain in water Suitable for indoor Christmas displays Quick and straightforward assembly Product Dimensions: H21.5 x W57 x D57cm Maximum Tree Height: 2.5m Maximum Trunk Diameter: 14cm Minimum Trunk Diameter: 5cm Water Capacity: 3.3L For use with real Christmas trees only. Adult assembly and installation required. Place the stand on a firm, level and stable surface and ensure all four legs are correctly fitted before inserting the tree. Suitable for trees up to 2.5m tall with a trunk diameter between 5cm and 14cm. Centre the trunk within the stand and tighten all securing screws evenly to ensure the tree remains upright and stable. Do not exceed the specified maximum tree height or trunk diameter. Regularly check the screws and stability of the tree throughout use and retighten if necessary. Keep the water reservoir adequately filled but do not overfill; wipe up spills immediately to prevent slip hazards and protect surrounding flooring. Keep the tree and stand away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, heaters and other direct heat sources. Do not allow children or pets to climb, pull or lean against the tree or stand. Take care when handling the metal legs and screws and discontinue use if any component becomes bent, damaged, loose or unstable. Keep small parts and packaging materials away from children. Neo Direct Ltd, Butterley Street, Leeds, LS10 1AW, United Kingdom
